pages.text: Park within 6 blocks of a $(item)Tuning Bench$() and right-click it to fit upgrade kits: fit your own free, or buy them from the bench's stock. Only a car's owner can have it tuned.
The Tune tab shows each kit and how far the car has it.

$(li)$(l)Engine Tune Kit$(): +6% speed a stage (up to 3)$(li)$(l)Turbocharger$(): +25% acceleration$(li)$(l)Sport Tires$(): turn sharper$(li)$(l)Off-Road Tires$(): less slowed off-road$(li)$(l)Winter Tires$(): grip on snow and ice

$(li)$(l)Performance Brakes$(): stop harder$(li)$(l)Lowering Springs$(): turn sharper$(li)$(l)Lift Kit$(): better off-road$(li)$(l)Extended Fuel Tank$() or $(l)Extra Battery Module$(): go further$(br2)Each costs something: more fuel, more wear, or a little speed.
